## Scope

One evidence-only control for the C269 H16.02 gap, authorized by the current fresh continuation request. Director: c270-h16-1242e9ec1f21. Starting main: 254e481351239b536394c182b6761ec4c8662764. Planned branch: work/c270-valid-siteref-control.

Independently freeze a source-valid declared SiteRef parameter and exact UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_FORM expectation before source/comparison execution. Retain input identities, reasons and all failures; require no partial qualified output. Preserve runtime, contracts, existing controls, fixtures, dependencies and budgets. If a defect appears, retain it and stop without repair.

## Acceptance and delivery

C270 R01–R05 cover independent validity/expectation, actual outcomes, affected checks and independent review, conditional evidence integration and actual-main verification, then verified saved handoff and separate receipt. Early recovery save is confirmed. H20/H22/H24 and broad qualification remain outside scope. Keep this issue open until every parent acceptance gate passes.

## Verified recovery finalization — November 20, 2026

PR #271 merged the exact reviewed evidence at `1afe569efc365caa6ec3203d3079dbc33d70349e`. Independent candidate review passed 429 static checks; fresh documentation/workflow checks passed on candidate, actual main and published checkpoint. Historical behavioral execution remains at `1ae7b594cc075031d11f2f1a33e4c5c0f0171da4`: 108 regression methods and 14 corpus bindings passed, while the three new H16 category assertions failed. No behavioral rerun or implementation correction occurred in recovery.

The final partial handoff and both matching prompts are confirmed saved after 2,129 independent package checks. [Separate delivery receipt](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/fbfa7701862bf49265043b194c2c509f62cb54c5/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c270/DELIVERY.json) identifies their exact saved versions, bytes and hashes. [Verified handoff ZIP](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-fb342ba3a2d48191be837ec9bab3566f_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal).

R01/R03/R04/R05 are complete for this phase. R02 remains unmet: the source-valid declared SiteRef is classified MALFORMED instead of the frozen UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_FORM expectation. C270 remains in_progress and this issue stays open. GitHub automatically deleted the merged work branch; the same `work/c270-valid-siteref-control` branch was restored and verified at retained head `4c53c3566cd18cb0f1fd47b02be6b23a40b40e68`.

## Next action

Finish receipt checks and release integration ownership, then stop the recovery phase. In a fresh main chat, explicitly declare one narrow classification correction under this existing parent and retained branch. Preserve the original failed control/expectation, distinguish valid unsupported SiteRef forms from genuine malformed references, inspect the C265→C266→C267→C268 pin chain and run every affected suite. No H20/H22/H24 expansion or second milestone is authorized in this recovery. Follow the live C270 task and NEXT-TASK records.
